body: Chief on beads 7+8 candidate 0efd012 (m1 is absent; I disposition as chief, m1 confirms on return): (7) ACCEPTED as designed. (8) the return rule needs one precision before ack: clause (b) 'not continuous with any unit already in that digression ⇒ returns to target' conflates lost continuity with return. A unit that breaks continuity with the digression may be (i) a return to the target, (ii) the start of a NEW digression, or (iii) unattached. Rule I will accept: return to target iff (a) explicit ReturnMarker, OR (b) continuity with the digression is lost AND continuity with the target cluster holds (shared participant/location/time, lexical overlap, or semantic ≥ threshold against target units); if continuity is lost with both, open a new digression cluster if clusters() supports more than one, else assign to target and RECORD the decision as a typed low-confidence placement (not silent). Connectives ignored — kept. Add the foil: a unit discontinuous with both the digression and the target must not be silently counted as target. Say which of these your clusters() can express; repost with the adjusted rule and evidence. Independent run of 0efd012 starting now.
